prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL SOULMONSTERS 2D MANGA environment concept panorama of SERRA DO MINUANO, contemporary Kronasta cold windy upland. WIDE 16:9 high three-quarter architectural-landscape overview. Crisp economical ink contours, broad FLAT LOCAL COLOR, ONE HARD CEL SHADOW per material, calm path surfaces, simplified grouped grasses, minimal marks on rock. No photorealism, painterly grain, 3D render or gritty texture. A dramatic climb through a SINGLE CONTINUOUS GROUNDED MOUNTAIN MASS, not floating islands, narrow suspended paths or stacked blocks.
Clearly THREE zones with increasing altitude: foreground broad foothill rest clearing; middle exposed switchback ledges with wide landings; rear upper summit clearing and tall distinctive split rock pinnacle framing open sky. Show FULL lateral rock faces and slopes supporting every walking shelf continuously down into the mountain. Paths 3-5 person widths where possible, short narrowing sections intentional. Broad natural ramps cut through rock connect three terraces, with wedge-shaped side slopes and open mouths, no vertical wall crossing ramp surface, no dangling strips of rock. One modest stone staircase near sheltered rest area only, not endless stair maze. Walking route rises left to right then back toward summit. A SECOND distinct foot route on opposite side of upper clearing rejoins main climb below for a loop descent, not a jump, teleport, zipline or gliding shortcut. No bridge required. A small darker side cleft suggests optional dangerous area, separate from main route.
FOREGROUND: small PRESENT-DAY trail refuge with pale sage insulated walls, asymmetric dark blue folded metal roof, big windbreak window, solar panel, a warm amber bench recess and emergency locker. Next to it a low impact weather mast/anemometer anchored on concrete pad and compact wayfinding post with color symbols only, no text. Upper slope has one small sturdy metal wind gauge and a few tied fabric wind indicators, no turbines everywhere. Wind implied by a few consistently swept grass clumps and ribbons; cold air, clear visibility, no blizzard. Upland vegetation only: sage/ochre grasses, hardy shrubs and two or three low twisted trees at foothill, sparse higher, not generic pine forest. Small residual snow in shaded far crevices ONLY, not frozen entire region.
SUMMIT: wide EMPTY natural oval clearing beneath split pinnacle, sheltered rock back wall with single subtle ancient diamond line-knot motif in masonry fragment; space for already-designed guardian MINUANO, but do NOT generate any creature or portrait. NOT a championship arena, no court markings, scoreboard, spectator stands or shrine altar. Character of ascent is earned by walking, no aerial shortcut.
Depth: distant lowlands, urban Kronasta and coastal water visible far below at left in muted simplified silhouette, atmospheric separation only in distance. Palette blue-grey/slate rock, pale warm stone path, sage/ochre sparse vegetation, cold cyan sky, selective snow ivory and amber refuge accent. Distinguish path top from cliff side with broad color planes, not millions of rock cracks. Large readable grounded land masses, rewarding panorama, breathing room. No medieval huts, bamboo, stone castle, random glowing crystals, HUD, text, annotations, logo or watermark. Professional original collectible-creature-game environment art, clean contemporary manga with coherent terrain.
